summary: Reviewed the committed Passport base-review CI capability and its regression tests. It defines the trusted deno policy on ci.yml, binds native and backup evidence to the exact base tree, workflow blob, job and producer, and fails closed on missing, red or mismatched evidence. No actionable defect was found.

evidence: src/github/base-review-service.ts now returns deno for ubiquity/passport.ubq.fi so facts no longer refuses the target CI policy as unavailable.

src/github/base-review-ci.ts binds native evidence to the exact base commit tree, ci.yml blob, single deno job and GitHub Actions producer, and verifies backup receipts by commit tree workflow job and parents before substituting a proven never-started job.

tests/github/base-review-passport-ci_test.ts and tests/github/base-review-service_test.ts exercise the production client and BaseTaskReviewService with fake ports, temporary state and native review, covering valid native and backup evidence plus stale, unsupported, absent, red and mismatched refusals while preserving the ambiguous charge, intent and counters.
